notes: LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions HF dataset card leaderboard (community, hand-maintained; says "The benchmark is independent: it is not affiliated with TypeSafe"). Stored: the first three zero-shot rows scored by the card author (meraGPT Decider 1, Liquid d1 d1:free, Jev 1.13.0). Not stored: the Featherless "Simple Jev" Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-classifier demo row (0.716, not the Decision Index Qwen3.8-27B entrant) and rows 5-10 (self-reported submitters, different hardware/units: prima-ratio, OpenDecider-small, Bongard-mini, Jeff-*). Fitted-on-train models are not comparable with the zero-shot table. Neither Clef nor Perplexity is on the card.

claims.statement: Card: "Request shape matters: in a third-party run Jev's yes/no accuracy was 0.843 with one question per request and 0.788 alongside the others." Hosted rows are p50 end to end from a client, one request at a time.
claims.implication: Test packed vs one-question requests; accuracy can change with the number of sibling questions.

scores.metric: typed-decisions card: accuracy vs teacher gold
scores.caveat: meraGPT; KL 0.096; price $0.03 per 1M input on the card; agreement with a ~4B-class teacher, ceiling 0.735
scores.harness: LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions test split: 400 cases, 2,000 decisions (600 noul, 600 choice, 800 score) across four workflows; zero-shot general models; whole case (state + all five questions) in one request; hosted rows p50 end to end from a client, one request at a time
